notes.title: Big Update Now Available As Preview Release!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32595029/15c4ed54792363a0ce08cf2aca175788b44cb60e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32595029/67195a15b0bd1d4adca7de8cbe5c5b491fe08653.png[/img][/url]
Great news, a big improvement is in the works! The next release is IN BETA RIGHT NOW and includes:
[list]
[*]A new flight space that combines grassland, alpine, desert and canyon environments.
[*]Detailed landscape materials that improve realism and immersion.
[*]A combination of procedurally generated trips and curated flights which highlight amazing views.
[*]In addition to the current antenna towers and wind turbines, there are new obstacles like oil rigs, water towers, barns and cows.
[*]A simplified menu system with four top-level choices - solo flight, mass ascension, night flight and competitive training.
[*]New demo modes that provide an introduction to virtual ballooning for friends and family.
[*]An enhanced in-air experience with other air traffic and new AI balloon patterns.
[*]An update to Unreal Engine 4.21 and many performance optimizations to the code.
[*]Tested on the RTX2080TI.
[/list]

Subscribe to the Lighter Than AR 'Preview' release branch to experience the latest in Virtual Ballooning tech. [url=https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=7021-EIAH-8669]  Details for accessing Steam Betas [/url]

notes.title: Lighter Than AR Now Supports Unreal Engine 4.19 and the Oculus Rift!
notes.content:
Flights using the Oculus Rift are cleared for takeoff!  The optics reflect the high standards of the Rift and are vivid and crisp with good handling of the bright sky as well as the landscape's shadows.

This release incorporates important new features from Unreal Engine 4.19 like: 
- Landscape Rendering Optimizations, that 'right-size' the terrain's details for the  VR headset and 
- Cloth Improvements that help the flags overhead flutter with changing wind gusts.

The tutorial level has been adapted to take place in Mesa country. In this new environment, your balloon glides over small hills then out over a vast canyon.
